summary: Session B verification for Tile Station admin: 3 new frontend pieces (FlooringManager page, BulkFieldsModal, BulkAIDescriptionsModal) + updated ManagerBulkBar (bar-bulk-fields / bar-ai-descriptions / bar-delete) + backend deleted_at:None regression. Backend pytest 9/9 pass (existing 8 + 1 new deleted_at:None regression using seeded Mongo doc). Frontend: /admin/flooring renders manager-tabs-bar with Flooring tab active (amber), all 5 sub-tabs present with counts (All Flooring 3 / LVT 0 / Laminate 0 / Wood 0 / Vinyl 0), 3 flooring rows visible (HE7013FSC Marwood Oak, HE7018FSC Samphire Oak, HE7012FSC Sandringham Oak from Canopy). Add-New-Flooring + Refresh buttons present. select-all → manager-bulk-bar appears at bottom with all 8 actions including bar-bulk-fields, bar-ai-descriptions, bar-delete, plus bar-assign-colours, bar-tier-pricing, bar-publish, bar-archive, bar-reassign-category. BulkFieldsModal opens with 4 field rows (Price/Cost/Stock/Sale %), ticked Price + entered 24.99 + saved → toast 'Updated 3 product(s)' + modal closed. BulkAIDescriptionsModal opens with 4 mode cards, Shorter mode + Start → progress bar animates 0→100%, success/failed counters update (0 success / 1 failed as expected — see backend issue). Materials Manager also shows all 3 new bar buttons, bar-delete → browser confirm dialog appears with message 'Delete 1 product(s) permanently?…', cancel dismissed → 138 rows unchanged after reload. Session A features (ManagerTabsBar, ManagerFiltersPanel, CustomManager) not re-tested per instructions.

critical.issue: SILENT SAVE FAILURE with false-positive verification. Sending {product_ids:['HE7013FSC'], id_field:'sku', updates:{list_price:24.99, retail_price:24.99}} (or 33.33) returns {success:true, supplier_products_updated:1, verification_checked:1, verification_failures:[], verification_ok:true}. GET-back on the same SKU shows list_price=62.99 (unchanged), retail_price=None. The 'verified save path' is verifying a DIFFERENT field than the one it wrote, or writing to a different sub-document than the read serializer reads from. This defeats the entire purpose of the verification framework — the BulkFieldsModal will silently mislead admins into thinking their price changes were saved. Reproduces 100% for list_price/retail_price on Canopy flooring SKUs HE7013FSC/HE7018FSC/HE7012FSC. Priority: CRITICAL — silent data loss.

Returns 401 with OpenAI-style error 'Incorrect API key provided: sk-emerg******************c0aF ... invalid_api_key' — the endpoint is forwarding to OpenAI with what appears to be the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY as-is (which OpenAI does not accept). Either the Emergent-LLM adapter is bypassed for this endpoint, or the wrong env var is being read. Every AI-description call fails. Bulk AI Descriptions modal correctly surfaces the failure (1 failed / 0 success).

integration_issues.issue: Toast reports success and modal closes, but underlying backend silently drops the list_price/retail_price update (see backend critical bug). FE code path is correct; backend is at fault.
AI endpoint returns 401 for every SKU; treated as passable per review request. Modal correctly shows 0 success / 1 failed and lists the error message.

issues: All 3 seeded Canopy Oak Engineered products are counted only under 'All Flooring (3)' — LVT/Laminate/Wood/Vinyl sub-tabs all show (0) because FLOOR_SUB_TABS.match() runs against product.type (empty) rather than product name or sub_categories. Since these are Engineered Oak floors, they SHOULD count under Wood. Fix: match against our_product_name/product_name in addition to product.type.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix silent save failure in bulk-update-unified for list_price/retail_price. Verification framework returns verification_ok:true even though GET-back shows the write did not persist. Either the endpoint isn't writing list_price at all (perhaps only certain whitelisted fields), or verification is reading from a different collection/field than the one written. Reproduce: POST bulk-update-unified with {product_ids:['HE7013FSC'], id_field:'sku', updates:{list_price:33.33}} → GET /api/supplier-sync/products → list_price still 62.99.

HIGH: Fix /api/products/generate-description — currently returning 401 from OpenAI with the Emergent LLM key. Ensure it uses emergentintegrations adapter, not a direct OpenAI SDK call with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY as the api_key.

MINOR: FlooringManager FLOOR_SUB_TABS match logic — engineered oak floors count only in 'All' but not in Wood sub-tab because it matches on product.type only. Add product name / sub_categories to the match predicate.
critical_code_review_comments: BulkFieldsModal.jsx: clean, correctly splits selection by sku vs supplier_code, surfaces verification_failures via toast.warning. Correctly checks all four apply-toggle checkboxes. NO frontend bug — the silent save failure is 100% backend.

BulkAIDescriptionsModal.jsx: end-of-loop toast message uses `progress.success + (progress.failed === 0 ? 1 : 0)` which double-counts when all fail — it prints 'Descriptions written: 1 success / 1 failed' when all failed. Minor cosmetic bug in the completion toast (the in-modal progress panel is correct).

useManagerBulk.js bulkDelete: sends updates:{status:'deleted', deleted_at:<iso>} via bulk-update-unified — this is a SOFT delete masquerading as a permanent delete. The prompt copy says 'Delete permanently? This can't be undone from the UI', which is misleading. Also depends on the (currently broken) bulk-update-unified path to actually persist — given the list_price bug above, `deleted_at` may or may not stick either. Recommend a dedicated /bulk-delete endpoint.

manager_definitions.py list_definitions/get_definition/patch/delete: the new $or filter {deleted_at:{$exists:false}} OR {deleted_at:null} is correct and verified end-to-end. Both list and by-slug endpoints exclude deleted_at:None docs.
FlooringManager.jsx (515 lines) is approaching the 700-line split threshold but not there yet. Sub-tab matcher uses only product.type — should also match name/sub_categories.

success_rate.backend: 100% pytest (9/9), but 2 critical runtime bugs discovered outside the manager_definitions suite (bulk-update-unified silent failure + generate-description 401)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 7 requested FE features render + work; failures observed downstream are backend

seed_data_creation: test_deleted_at_none_alive_and_deleted seeds + cleans up manager_definitions doc slug=test-deleted-at-none-regression. Also flipped list_price on HE7013FSC via curl during debugging (still at 62.99 due to bug — no material impact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Session B FE (FlooringManager + BulkFieldsModal + BulkAIDescriptionsModal + updated ManagerBulkBar) is all rendering and wired correctly. Two backend-side critical issues were uncovered while exercising the new UI: (1) POST /api/supplier-sync/products/bulk-update-unified reports verification_ok:true but does NOT persist list_price/retail_price updates on flooring SKUs (HE7013FSC/HE7018FSC/HE7012FSC) — repro via plain curl. (2) POST /api/products/generate-description forwards to OpenAI with an invalid key and returns 401 for every call. Both need the main agent's attention. Frontend key testids to reuse: manager-tabs-bar, manager-tab-flooring, flooring-select-all, flooring-tab-{all|lvt|laminate|wood|vinyl}, flooring-add-new-btn, flooring-refresh-btn, flooring-row-{sku}, manager-bulk-bar, bar-bulk-fields, bar-ai-descriptions, bar-delete, bar-assign-colours, bar-tier-pricing, bar-publish, bar-unpublish, bar-archive, bar-reassign-category, bulk-fields-modal, bulk-fields-price/cost/stock/sale, bulk-fields-save, bulk-ai-descriptions-modal, bulk-ai-mode-{generate|regenerate|shorter|longer}, bulk-ai-start, bulk-ai-progress-bar.
rca of the issue: Bulk price save silent failure: bulk-update-unified `verification_checked` counter increments but the intent-vs-actual comparison must be scoped to a whitelist of fields that DOESN'T include list_price/retail_price (or the write itself is writing to a nested location like tier_pricing.list_price rather than root list_price). The read serializer at GET /api/supplier-sync/products returns list_price from the root document. Fix path: (a) confirm the write in supplier_sync.bulk_update_unified maps 'list_price' → root, and (b) ensure verification loops over EVERY key in `updates` (not just a hardcoded whitelist). AI 401: /api/products/generate-description uses OpenAI SDK directly with os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY']=EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — OpenAI rejects the emergent key format. Should route through emergentintegrations.llm.chat.LlmChat.
